sources.entry: Stretto ⚠ - Music player with Youtube/Soundcloud import and iTunes/Spotify discovery. (Demo, Clients) MIT Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Stretto Android is a React Native client app for playing music from a Stretto library on Android devices.
summary.what_it_does: The app is an Android client for Stretto, built with react-native. It syncs the user's library from the hosted Stretto website and plays tracks through a separate stretto-streamer endpoint. The README says it only supports Android currently, with iOS left for others to test and fix. It can be installed from the Play Store for auto-updates, or the latest committed build can be downloaded from the repository. The README describes developer setup with yarn and npm scripts to run the Metro bundler and deploy a debug build to a connected Android device.
use_cases: listen to my Stretto music library on Android
play music streamed from a self-hosted Stretto server on a phone
install a mobile music player client for Stretto
develop or build a react-native Android music app
notable: Syncs the library from the hosted Stretto website
Streams tracks through a separate stretto-streamer endpoint
Available on the Play Store with auto-updates
caveats: Android only; the README says iOS is not supported and needs testers and fixes
Depends on a Stretto website and a separate stretto-streamer endpoint being available
Developer setup needs a plugged-in Android device for the debug deploy
keywords: listen to my library on android
